Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

r4subusability (development version)

  • Add usability_report(): a consolidated rollup that runs every usability check in the package over one metadata frame in a single call and assembles the results into one usability_report object. It orchestrates the scored indicators (usability_indicators(), U-001..U-004) and the advisory diagnostics (label_consistency(), variable_name_conformance(), variable_attribute_consistency()), returning a tidy per-check summary (pass/warn/fail/na counts and finding counts), a single combined findings frame of the offending items, and the combined R4SUB evidence. It invents no new criteria: the overall score is exactly the weighted score from usability_summary() over the scored indicators, and the diagnostics contribute descriptive finding counts only. A print() method is included.
  • Add variable_attribute_consistency(): a descriptive diagnostic that reports variables whose data attributes (type, length, format) drift across the datasets in which they appear. A variable name shared by several datasets is expected to carry the same type, length, and format everywhere; mismatches are reported as a tidy tibble, one row per affected dataset per attribute. The attributes checked are configurable and absent columns are skipped. It is purely additive and does not affect existing usability scores.
  • Add variable_name_conformance(): a descriptive diagnostic that checks variable and dataset names against the SAS v5 transport (XPT) naming constraints (maximum length of eight characters; upper-case letters, digits, and underscore only; not starting with a digit). The limits are configurable and the result is a tidy tibble of non-conforming names with the reason. It is purely additive and does not affect existing usability scores.
  • Add label_consistency(): a descriptive diagnostic that reports duplicate labels within a dataset, the same variable name carrying inconsistent labels across datasets, and missing dataset-level (table) labels, as a tidy tibble. It is purely additive and does not affect existing usability scores.
  • Fix the README quick-start example, which called usability_indicators() with a non-existent study_id argument and omitted the required run context.
  • Correct the usability-indicators vignette: drop the stale "ARG" entry from the documented reviewer_guide_keywords defaults, and describe the reviewer guide match as word-boundary (not substring) matching, to match the code.

r4subusability 0.2.1

  • Fix the pkgdown workflow so it resolves ecosystem dependencies, and polish metadata for CRAN.

r4subusability 0.2.0

  • Add vignette: “Case study: reviewer experience from ADaM metadata”, which builds a Define-style view from the example CDISC pilot metadata in r4subdata and measures its usability.

  • Clarified the package DESCRIPTION: “R4SUB” expands to “Ready for Submission” (previously “R for Regulatory Submission”, inconsistent with the rest of the ecosystem).

r4subusability 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • usability_config_default(): default configuration for usability assessments.
  • assess_label_quality(): check variable label presence and length (U-001).
  • assess_define_completeness(): check Define-XML origin and derivation fields (U-002).
  • assess_annotation_coverage(): check proportion of derived variables annotated (U-003).
  • assess_reviewer_guide(): check reviewer guide presence in submission package (U-004).
  • usability_indicators(): run all four assessments in one call.
  • usability_summary() and print.usability_result(): summarise and display results.
